title: What Does It Really Take to Make it on Wall Street?
summary: What does it really take to build a lasting career on Wall Street? Cboe’s Stacey Gilbert joins Interactive Brokers’ Judith Casasampere to reflect on nearly three decades in the derivatives industry and to share lessons on risk-taking, failure, mentorship, confidence, and finding opportunities to grow.
